# uptrace Provider

Manage Uptrace organizations, projects, monitors, notification channels, teams, users, and project tokens.

## Example Usage

```terraform
provider "uptrace" {
  endpoint = "http://localhost:14318"
  token    = "your-api-token"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `endpoint` (String) Uptrace API endpoint. Can also be set with the UPTRACE_ENDPOINT environment variable.
- `token` (String, Sensitive) Uptrace API token. Can also be set with the UPTRACE_TOKEN environment variable.
